data.name: Arisha
data.gender_notes: Arisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A precious gift from Allah, symbolizing divine blessings and favors. The name Arisha carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Arisha usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's generosity and kindness.
data.etymology: Arisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arisha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: أريشا
in_arabic.long_meaning: أريشا هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ومعناه الفتاة الجميلة والخجولة، وهي كلمة مشتقة من الأصل السامي، وتستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتعبير عن الجمال والأنوثة

in_urdu.name: آریشا
in_urdu.long_meaning: آریشا ایک عربی اصل کا نام ہے جو اسلامی ثقافت میں خوبصورت اور شَرَمناک لڑکی کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم ثقافت میں بھی عام ہے

in_hindi.name: अरीशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अरीशा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जो इस्लामी संस्कृति में सुंदर और शर्मीली लड़की के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी आम है

in_pashto.name: اریشه

data.cultural_impact: The name Arisha might not have a distinctive cultural association as it is relatively uncommon and can be found across various Muslim communities. However, it's a beautiful name that carries a sense of grace and elegance, often associated with purity, sophistication and prosperity. In many Middle Eastern cultures, it is customary to assign names with deep meaning and significance, which makes a name like Arisha an appreciate choice.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arisha holds great spiritual significance through its Arabic roots, which can be traced back to the meaning "a precious gift from Allah" or "a favor bestowed by Allah". It is believed that the bestowal of a name can have a profound impact on an individual's life, as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "Call your child by a good name, for it is a part of his religion" (Sahih Muslim, Book 33). With the name Arisha, one is constantly reminded of the divine blessings and favors that come from Allah, and that every good thing comes from Him – a source of inspiration and gratitude.
